hints.title: Bipartition Binary Masking
hints.text: Represent each assignment of items into subset A and subset B using an n-bit binary mask.

hints.title: Bitwise Function Evaluation
hints.text: Compute the bitwise exclusive or across elements in A and the bitwise conjunction across elements in B.

hints.title: Global Score Maximization
hints.text: Combine the two evaluations and maintain the maximal composite sum over all non-trivial masks.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Exact subset enumeration over binary partition masks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrary non-contiguous partitions require subset exploration.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct bitmask iteration uses constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enumerate binary bipartition masks cleanly and compute bitwise metrics.
